mapper.sql: and ( u.user_id = 1 or 3 = ( select count(distinct approval_m.perms) from sys_user_role approval_ur inner join sys_role approval_r on approval_r.role_id = approval_ur.role_id inner join sys_role_menu approval_rm on approval_rm.role_id = approval_r.role_id inner join sys_menu approval_m on approval_m.menu_id = approval_rm.menu_id where approval_ur.user_id = u.user_id and approval_r.status = '0' and approval_r.del_flag = '0' and approval_r.role_id <> 1 and approval_m.status = '0' and approval_m.perms in ( 'workflow:process:todoList', 'workflow:process:query', 'workflow:process:approval' ) ) )

and ( u.user_id = 1 or 5 = ( select count(distinct claim_m.perms) from sys_user_role claim_ur inner join sys_role claim_r on claim_r.role_id = claim_ur.role_id inner join sys_role_menu claim_rm on claim_rm.role_id = claim_r.role_id inner join sys_menu claim_m on claim_m.menu_id = claim_rm.menu_id where claim_ur.user_id = u.user_id and claim_r.status = '0' and claim_r.del_flag = '0' and claim_r.role_id <> 1 and claim_m.status = '0' and claim_m.perms in ( 'workflow:process:claimList', 'workflow:process:claim', 'workflow:process:todoList', 'workflow:process:query', 'workflow:process:approval' ) ) )

choose.when:
select count(*) from sys_user u where u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0'
and (u.nick_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.user_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

select count(*) from sys_role r where r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0'
and (r.role_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or r.role_key like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
choose.otherwise:
select count(*) from sys_dept d where d.status = '0' and d.del_flag = '0'
and d.dept_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')

mapper.select:
select cast(u.user_id as char) as option_value, concat(u.nick_name, ' (', u.user_name, ')') as option_label, 'user' as option_type from sys_user u where u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0'
and (u.nick_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.user_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by u.user_name, u.user_id
select concat('ROLE', r.role_id) as option_value, concat('角色: ', r.role_name) as option_label, 'role' as option_type from sys_role r where r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0'
and (r.role_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or r.role_key like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by r.role_sort, r.role_id
select concat('DEPT', d.dept_id) as option_value, concat('部门: ', d.dept_name) as option_label, 'dept' as option_type from sys_dept d where d.status = '0' and d.del_flag = '0'
and d.dept_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
order by d.order_num, d.dept_id
limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}

)

select distinct u.user_id from sys_user u where u.user_id in
#{userId}
and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0'
order by u.user_id

select distinct u.user_id from sys_user u where u.user_id in
#{userId}
and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0'
order by u.user_id

select distinct r.role_id from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' order by r.role_id
select d.dept_id from sys_user u inner join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and d.del_flag = '0'

select distinct u.user_id from sys_dept d inner join sys_user u on u.user_name = d.leader and u.dept_id = d.dept_id and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' where d.dept_id in
#{deptId}
and d.status = '0' and d.del_flag = '0'
order by u.user_id

select distinct scope_dept.dept_id from sys_user u inner join sys_dept member_dept on member_dept.dept_id = u.dept_id and member_dept.status = '0' and member_dept.del_flag = '0' inner join sys_dept scope_dept on (scope_dept.dept_id = member_dept.dept_id or find_in_set(scope_dept.dept_id, member_dept.ancestors)) and scope_dept.status = '0' and scope_dept.del_flag = '0' where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' order by scope_dept.dept_id

select distinct u.user_id from sys_user starter inner join sys_dept starter_dept on starter_dept.dept_id = starter.dept_id and starter_dept.status = '0' and starter_dept.del_flag = '0' inner join sys_dept manager_dept on manager_dept.dept_id = case when starter_dept.leader = starter.user_name then starter_dept.parent_id else starter_dept.dept_id end and manager_dept.status = '0' and manager_dept.del_flag = '0' inner join sys_user u on u.user_name = manager_dept.leader and u.dept_id = manager_dept.dept_id and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' where starter.user_id = #{userId} and starter.status = '0' and starter.del_flag = '0' and u.user_id <> starter.user_id
order by u.user_id

select distinct u.user_id from sys_user starter inner join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = starter.dept_id and d.status = '0' and d.del_flag = '0' inner join sys_user u on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id and ur.role_id = #{roleId} inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' where starter.user_id = #{userId} and starter.status = '0' and starter.del_flag = '0'
order by u.user_id
